book.title: Luka Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Lukaꞌa Mirihiro

content: Iesu zu Zakaio
Iesuꞌa Ieriko diuḡadu vitau onaminu.
Eꞌea vaze ꞌahoga niḡa Zakaioꞌa radiunu. Aniꞌe takesi vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡa zu maꞌora vazeḡa.
Ani Iesuꞌe iniu rae ḡianihi reiro, rehano aniꞌe vaze futuꞌa ꞌahine, vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa boꞌaḡano Iesu horonogaꞌe mene idararo.
Eꞌanoꞌo ani Iesu ḡianoga radu dure ibitiro, ebu Hiru ireḡa
ꞌahoga sibiriro, mazaḡa Iesuꞌa eꞌe ibiḡano vitaꞌuma rae reiro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa eꞌe habaꞌano feurirotene, ite ehamanadu Zakaio niro, “Zakaio, ḡarihe bua ovaoꞌi. E izidi ḡae neo radiꞌuma.”
ꞌOugadu Zakaioꞌe ḡarihe sibire buanadu matuꞌeꞌenaꞌa, ane neo Iesu mae ḡihiniro.
Vaze niduꞌa eꞌe horonadu gumude ḡoeriro, “Iesuꞌa haḡai sauꞌa vazeḡa neo diuḡadu radiuꞌohe.”

Ebu Zakaioꞌa edanadu Zuhiꞌa Boro niro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, ḡianoꞌi. E izidi eḡe ḡau niduꞌaonoꞌo ḡahaꞌa zahara azaḡa ziniꞌuma. Ebu eḡeꞌa vaze soꞌozadu ḡau ꞌahoga meiniro reine, ḡae ḡazaḡa bare baronoziniꞌuma.”
ꞌOugadu Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Izidi ḡa zu ḡae teite ne tibano radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa ḡabone hideha. Izidi Zakaio zuni Aberahamo mariga.
Vaze Ubugaꞌe dauḡiroteꞌe azaḡa vaḡadu ḡabozoga veize ariro.”
Tuḡure Azaḡa Gaubanana Hari Idaidaḡa
Iesuꞌa Ierusalema hanitirotene vaze niduꞌa ꞌahige rae zamariro, “Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe madaḡaniꞌa zogone fureraꞌuma.” ꞌOugadu ze Iesu ḡoere ꞌize abiteꞌeteꞌea, Iesuꞌa hari ꞌahoga idane ziro,
“Niḡa boro vazeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa radiunu. Aniꞌa kini iḡuri mouga veize haba faḡa onamadu bare arihi rae reiro.
Aniꞌa iḡuniroteꞌe madaḡano tuḡureḡa azaḡa gaubanana huzadu zeḡe tibatiba hadi silivaḡa tibatiba
ziniro. Ebu aniꞌa ziro, 'Hadi ꞌahi hina gauadu hadi borofoꞌi, onamo eḡeꞌa bare ariꞌuma.'
U ane haba azaḡaniꞌa ani heꞌeheꞌenadu ane ḡaruna hari odohe onameꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa tuḡunadu haba zuhiꞌaḡa mazao uminiro, 'Eme aniꞌe emeḡe kini rouga mene urateꞌohe.'
Rehano haba zuhiꞌaḡaniꞌa ani kinio ohonadu bare ariro. Ebu hadi silivaḡa ziniroteꞌe tuḡure azaḡa huzadu zeꞌa nougenouge hadi borofirotaꞌaꞌe ederihi rae reiro.
Ebu tuḡure vazeḡa ibiꞌaniꞌa ane vaḡe aradu niro, 'Zuhiꞌa, ḡaeꞌa iniroteꞌe hadi silivaḡa tiba hina hadi silivaḡa gaubanana ragate haḡairo.'
Ane zuhiꞌaꞌa niro, 'Manoḡa taugi, ḡaꞌe tuḡure vazeḡa manoḡa! Ḡaeꞌa zamaḡo niduꞌa hina gau komeꞌa faine odohe gauiro ꞌahine, ne niduꞌa gaubanana ḡianeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡano ohoꞌiꞌuma.'
Ebu tuḡure vazeḡa aheuḡaniꞌa aradu niro, 'Zuhiꞌa, ḡaeꞌa iniroteꞌe hadi silivaḡa tiba hina hadi silivaḡa fuꞌo ragate haḡairo.'
Zuhiꞌaḡaniꞌa naenaeniro, 'Manoḡa tauḡi! Ḡa zuni ne niduꞌa fuꞌo ḡianeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡano ohoꞌiꞌuma.'
Rehano tuḡure vazeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa aradu niro, 'Zuhiꞌa, ḡae hadiꞌe ꞌahi eꞌe. Eḡeꞌa mene daunoga veize dabua hina ꞌumadu ꞌuꞌuru tiro.
Ḡaꞌe vaze riḡa. Vazeꞌa tiroteꞌe ḡauḡa ḡaeꞌa maꞌohe, zu vazeꞌa ḡoraroteꞌe ḡauḡa ḡaeꞌa hiriveꞌohe. Eꞌanoꞌo e ḡa rihoꞌadu ꞌouge haḡairo.'
Zuhiꞌaḡaniꞌa niro, 'Ḡaꞌe tuḡure vazeḡa sauꞌa! Ḡaeꞌa rateꞌe ḡoeꞌa uꞌano, e aduga ḡaniꞌuma! Ḡae zamarone, eꞌe vaze riḡa radu e vazeꞌa tiroteꞌe ḡauḡa maꞌohe zu ḡoraroteꞌe ḡauḡa hiriveꞌohe rae ederirohe?
ꞌOugirotene, ḡa nougadu hadi tiꞌeteꞌe neḡano eḡe hadi mene tiro? ꞌOugifone, e bare aradu hadi eꞌe bare ragate meifo.'
Ebu ani vaetadu uhiḡano edaroteꞌe azaḡa ziro, 'Ani mazaonoꞌo hadi silivaḡa tiba eꞌe moꞌi, ebu hadi silivaḡa gaubanana meiroteꞌe tuḡure vazeḡa hanoꞌi.'
Rehano zeḡeꞌa niro, 'Zuhiꞌa, ani hadi silivaḡa gaubanana amahi meiro.'
Ani naenaeziro, 'Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe. Iniuꞌa nagini hidiroteꞌe faine odohe gauine, ani bare borofe hidiꞌuma. Rehano iniuꞌa nagini hidiroteꞌe mene faine odohe gauine, ani mazao nagini komeꞌa zuni meiniꞌuma.
Ebu eḡeꞌa kini rouga mene uratiroteꞌe agire azaḡa tutuze aradu eḡe zamao mau ruzoꞌi.'”
Iesuꞌa Ierusalema Diuḡiro
Iesuꞌa ḡoere hauḡadu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa vitize Ierusalema uꞌa itiro.
Ebu aniꞌa Olivi Maḡano Betefage zu Betania neḡano feurirotene, ane tahiꞌa aheu tuḡuzeꞌenaꞌa ziro,
“Zama mone neḡa onamoꞌi. Eꞌe neḡa diuḡine, vazeni ꞌahoga mene ehoriroteꞌe donikiḡa ubuga batune touga horoniꞌuma. Ebu fuhiꞌadu ꞌahi zamahu aroꞌi.
Vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa, 'Nougadu fuiꞌeꞌohe?' rae ḡadizoꞌidene, 'Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa urateꞌohe,' rae noꞌi.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa tuḡuziroteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa ibite ne eꞌe onamirotene, Iesuꞌa ziroteꞌe teige doniki ubuga ꞌahoga horoniro.
Ze doniki ubuga eꞌe fuhiꞌiroteꞌe zamaḡano doniki taufeꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa ḡadiziro, “Za nougadu doniki ubuga fuhiꞌeꞌohe?”
Zeꞌa naenaeziro, “Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa urateꞌohe.” Ze ꞌouge reirotene doniki taufeꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa ziniro.
Ebu ze doniki ubuga tutune Iesu vaḡe aradu dabuaze doniki ubuga ḡarunio zahariro, ebu Iesuꞌa eꞌe rana tire ehoriro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa onameꞌeteꞌea, vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa dabuaze ane ibio hiraro.

Ebu Iesuꞌa Olivi Maḡanonoꞌo ovoeꞌeteꞌe ibiḡa hanitirotene, ane hegoteꞌeteꞌe vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa niduꞌa onameꞌenaꞌa, matuꞌuzeta huaro zu Badiꞌa niguniro, mazaḡa ze Iesuꞌa haḡainuteꞌe haḡai gigiꞌaḡa niduꞌa horoniro.
Zeꞌa ꞌahige rae reiro,

content.text: “Zuhiꞌa Boro niḡano areꞌeteꞌe kiniḡaꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune!

content: Rehano vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa boꞌaḡano Farisea azaḡa nuꞌa Iesu niro, “Ihore vazeḡa, ḡa hegoteꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa ꞌouge huauꞌeteꞌe gararoꞌi!”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, ze sifu radiune, hadi niduꞌa ḡihau huaꞌuma.”
Iesuꞌa Ierusalema uꞌano Niaro
Iesuꞌa Ierusalema hanitadu eꞌe horonirotene niaro.
Ebu aniꞌa reiro, “Ierusalema azaḡa, izidi zaꞌe uniho manoḡa maꞌeteꞌe ibiḡa ederifone, manoḡa reifo. Rehano izidi za eꞌe ederoga mene idaḡa.
Mada ꞌahoganiꞌa zae mazao fureraꞌuma. Eꞌe madaḡano zae agire azaḡaniꞌa raha ḡabiꞌa haḡadu merau ganaḡeḡeziꞌuma, ebu zamao haoziꞌuma.

Zeḡeꞌa zae haba zu haba azaḡa niduꞌa rahao zimi feuziꞌuma. Ebu zae ne ogoraroteꞌe hadiḡa niduꞌa fahe ḡuzuhadu hadini ꞌahoga hadi ꞌahoga ranao mene radiꞌuma, mazaḡa zaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa zae vaḡe ariroteꞌe madaḡa mene ederiro.”
Iesuꞌa Kuru Neḡa Deheniro
Ebu Iesuꞌa kuru neḡa habaꞌano diuḡadu serosero azaḡa hegoze buziro.
Ebu aniꞌa ziro, “Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae mirihiro, 'Badiꞌa neꞌe kuru neḡa reꞌuma.' Rehano zaeꞌa kuru neḡaꞌe ḡonore azaḡa neḡano ḡihuniro.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa mada niduꞌa kuru neḡano ihoziro. Rehano dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa, Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa zu vaze ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa ani matihi reiro.
Rehano ze ani matiteꞌe ibiḡa ꞌahoga mene horoniro, mazaḡa vaze niduꞌa Iesu ḡoere faifaine abitinu.
